name: Review run severity counters filter findings and open a per-severity modal
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab. The seeded run (open by default) has 1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING finding, so the severity counter row shows '1 CRITICAL' and '1 WARNING'. Clicking '1 WARNING' filters the list to the N+1 query finding; clicking it again restores the full list (the critical Stripe-key finding is back). The ⓘ button on the CRITICAL pill opens a modal listing that severity's findings; Close dismisses it. Read-only seeded data (no model call). agent-browser can only wait for text to appear, not assert absence, so 'filtered out' is covered by the client unit tests (FindingsPanel.test.tsx). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
